intent: Detect fraudulent archived payment records via impossible-travel speed over payment history and cite each flagged record.
success_criteria: Only payment_transactions with is_archived_basket_reference=1 are considered
Per customer_id, ordered by payment_created_at, incoming and outgoing leg speeds are computed in deg/hr
Records whose incoming OR outgoing leg exceeds ~2 deg/hr are flagged as fraud
No files are written or deleted (read-only)
Every flagged payment's record_path is cited in refs
/docs/security.md is cited as the applied policy

args.stdin:
WITH archived AS (
  SELECT payment_id, record_path, customer_id, payment_created_at,
         observed_latitude AS lat, observed_longitude AS lon
  FROM payment_transactions
  WHERE is_archived_basket_reference = 1
),
legs AS (
  SELECT a.*,
    LAG(lat)  OVER w AS prev_lat,
    LAG(lon)  OVER w AS prev_lon,
    LAG(payment_created_at)  OVER w AS prev_t,
    LEAD(lat) OVER w AS next_lat,
    LEAD(lon) OVER w AS next_lon,
    LEAD(payment_created_at) OVER w AS next_t
  FROM archived a
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_created_at)
),
speeds AS (
  SELECT *,
    (ABS(lat-prev_lat)+ABS(lon-prev_lon)) / NULLIF((julianday(payment_created_at)-julianday(prev_t))*24.0,0) AS in_speed,
    (ABS(next_lat-lat)+ABS(next_lon-lon)) / NULLIF((julianday(next_t)-julianday(payment_created_at))*24.0,0) AS out_speed
  FROM legs
)
SELECT record_path, payment_id, customer_id, payment_created_at, in_speed, out_speed
FROM speeds
WHERE in_speed > 2.0 OR out_speed > 2.0
ORDER BY customer_id, payment_created_at;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Fraud review over archived payments (is_archived_basket_reference=1): impossible-travel detection per customer ordered by payment_created_at. Flagged {fraud_records.count} payment record(s) whose incoming OR outgoing leg speed exceeds ~2 deg/hr (faster than ground travel): {fraud_records.payment_ids}. Files left unchanged. Applied policy: /docs/security.md.
